text: Manzanilla from Jerez? No such thing.
say: Manzanilla from Hereth? No such thing.

text: It starts with albariza: chalk soil that holds water, even in summer.
say: It starts with alba-reetha: chalk soil that holds water, even in summer.

text: It lies between Jerez, Sanlúcar and El Puerto.
say: It lies between Hereth, San Lookar and El Pwairto.

text: From the west blows the poniente, cool and damp, off the ocean.
say: From the west blows the ponn-yentay, cool and damp, off the ocean.

text: Damp air feeds the flor: the yeast on fino and manzanilla.
say: Damp air feeds the flor: the yeast on fino and manzanilla.

text: In Sanlúcar, at the river mouth, that layer stays thick all year.
say: In San Lookar, at the river mouth, that layer stays thick all year.
Manzanilla ages only in San Lookar.

text: From the east comes the levante: hot and dry.
say: From the east comes the lev-antay: hot and dry.
